title: Compatible etale-origin witnesses for normalized finite-coefficient towers
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme, let $(A,I)$ be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and put $P_n=A/I^n$ for $n\geq1$. Use the constant finite coefficient sheaves and exact comparison inverse image $\nu_T^*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. For every $n$ let $M_n\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{proet}},P_n)$ and choose an etale-origin witness $L_n\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$, $\alpha_n:\nu_T^*L_n\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Suppose given isomorphisms
$$\rho_{m,n}:M_m\otimes^L_{(P_m)_T}(P_n)_T\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n\qquad(m\geq n\geq1)$$
with $\rho_{n,n}=1$ and $\rho_{m,n}(\rho_{k,m}\otimes^LP_n)=\rho_{k,n}$ under scalar-extension associativity for $k\geq m\geq n$, using derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].

Then $L_m\otimes^L_{P_m}P_n$ belongs to $D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$, and there are unique isomorphisms
$$\beta_{m,n}:L_m\otimes^L_{P_m}P_n\xrightarrow{\sim}L_n$$
such that
$$\alpha_n\circ\nu_T^*\beta_{m,n}=\rho_{m,n}\circ(\alpha_m\otimes^LP_n).$$
The source of this equality is identified by the canonical tensor comparison for inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. These isomorphisms satisfy $\beta_{n,n}=1$ and $\beta_{m,n}(\beta_{k,m}\otimes^LP_n)=\beta_{k,n}$ under scalar-extension associativity. In particular, the chosen origins admit witnesses compatible with all the supplied normalization maps. No uniform cohomological interval, constructibility, or finite Tor dimension is assumed.

source.place: Proof, compatible etale-origin witness sentence; formal refinement using Stacks Tag 09B1, proetale.tex, lemma-compare-derived (2), together with coefficient reduction; the compatible tower assertion is an agent-written refinement, not the literal Stacks statement

proof.text:
Write $F_n=\nu_T^*$ at coefficient ring $P_n$, and $C_{m,n}=L_m\otimes^L_{P_m}P_n$, initially in the unbounded derived category. The rings $P_n$ are finite by [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. The coefficient sheaves and exact termwise functors $F_n$ are those of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] to the comparison of ringed topoi gives the canonical coefficient-reduction comparison
$$c_{m,n}:F_n C_{m,n}\xrightarrow{\sim}(F_mL_m)\otimes^L_{P_m}P_n.$$
Here this is an isomorphism of $P_n$-complexes, including the quotient action: take a K-flat resolution $Q\to L_m$ with flat terms; its pullback is K-flat by the cited lemma. Both sides are computed from $Q\otimes_{P_m}P_n$ by exact inverse image and the ordinary tensor comparison. This comparison carries the scalar action on the last $P_n$ factor to the same action on the other side. Derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] computes these quotient tensors by $Q$ and makes their comparisons independent of the resolution.

source.place: Tag 09B1, lemma-compare-derived (2); agent-written coefficient-reduction and cocycle refinement

proof.text:
We will use the naturality and quotient associativity of these canonical comparisons. They can be checked on the preceding K-flat models. Extension of a K-flat $P_k$-complex $Q$ to $P_m$ is K-flat over $P_m$: for an acyclic $P_m$-complex $N$, its tensor with $Q\otimes_{P_k}P_m$ is $Q\otimes_{P_k}N$, acyclic since restriction of scalars leaves the underlying complex unchanged. Thus the two-stage extension is computed by ordinary balancing. For $k\geq m\geq n$, both association maps send
$$((x\otimes a)\otimes b)\longmapsto x\otimes q_{m,n}(a)b.$$
Pullback has the same balancing formula, while a chain map $h$ replaces $x$ by $h(x)$ on both paths. This proves quotient-associativity, the unit case $x\otimes a\mapsto ax$, and naturality of $c$ on these models; [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] descends them through quasi-isomorphisms. In particular these are the associativity identifications stipulated in the statement, with the same quotient-ring actions. No flatness of $P_n$ over $P_m$ is used.

source.place: Tag 09B1, lemma-compare-derived (2); agent-written coefficient-reduction and cocycle refinement

proof.text: Compose $c_{m,n}$, $\alpha_m\otimes^LP_n$, and $\rho_{m,n}$ to obtain an isomorphism $F_nC_{m,n}\cong M_n$. Choose a lower cohomological bound $a_n$ for $M_n$. By [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level], $F_n$ is exact and every etale $P_n$-module sheaf $H$ has $H\cong\nu_{T,*}F_nH$. Exactness identifies $F_n\mathcal H^i(C_{m,n})$ with $\mathcal H^i(F_nC_{m,n})$: apply $F_n$ to kernels and images of the differentials and to their quotient. For $i<a_n$ this is zero. Apply the sheaf-level unit to $H=\mathcal H^i(C_{m,n})$ to get $H\cong\nu_{T,*}0=0$. Hence $C_{m,n}\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$. This argument works for each pair separately and supplies no uniform bound.

source.place: Tag 09B1, lemma-compare-derived (2); agent-written coefficient-reduction and cocycle refinement

proof.text:
Now both $C_{m,n}$ and $L_n$ are bounded below. By [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison], $F_n$ is fully faithful on these categories. Set
$$d_{m,n}=\alpha_n^{-1}\rho_{m,n}(\alpha_m\otimes^LP_n)c_{m,n}:F_nC_{m,n}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_nL_n.$$
Fullness gives a morphism $\beta_{m,n}$ with image $d_{m,n}$ and a morphism with image $d_{m,n}^{-1}$. Faithfulness identifies their two composites with identities, so $\beta_{m,n}$ is invertible. Faithfulness also makes it unique. Multiplying $F_n\beta_{m,n}=d_{m,n}$ by $\alpha_n$ gives precisely the required compatibility equation, with its source identified by $c_{m,n}$.

source.place: Tag 09B1, lemma-compare-derived (2); agent-written coefficient-reduction and cocycle refinement

proof.text: For $m=n$, use the canonical unit identifications $L_n\otimes^L_{P_n}P_n=L_n$ and $M_n\otimes^L_{P_n}P_n=M_n$. The unit comparison from Step 2 and the assumed $\rho_{n,n}=1$ give $d_{n,n}=\alpha_n^{-1}\alpha_n=1$. Since [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison] makes $F_n$ faithful, $\beta_{n,n}=1$.

source.place: Tag 09B1, lemma-compare-derived (2); agent-written coefficient-reduction and cocycle refinement

proof.text:
Fix $k\geq m\geq n$. Both sides of the desired equation have source $C_{k,n}$: Step 2 identifies $(L_k\otimes^L_{P_k}P_m)\otimes^L_{P_m}P_n$ with $C_{k,n}$, already bounded below by Step 3. Use the naturality and association of $c$ checked in Step 2, and the compatibility equations of Step 4. After applying $F_n$ and then $\alpha_n$, the image of the two-stage composite is
$$\begin{aligned}
\alpha_nF_n\bigl(\beta_{m,n}(\beta_{k,m}\otimes^LP_n)\bigr)
&=\rho_{m,n}(\alpha_m\otimes^LP_n)(F_m\beta_{k,m}\otimes^LP_n)\\
&=\rho_{m,n}(\rho_{k,m}\otimes^LP_n)(\alpha_k\otimes^LP_n)\\
&=\rho_{k,n}(\alpha_k\otimes^LP_n)
=\alpha_nF_n\beta_{k,n}.
\end{aligned}$$
All displayed sources are identified by $c$ and scalar-extension associativity, as verified on the balanced models in Step 2. The middle equality is the assumed cocycle for $\rho$. Cancel the invertible $\alpha_n$ and then use faithfulness from [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]. This proves the cocycle for $\beta$, and completes the compatible witness data.

tool_uses.why: Generic K-flat change-of-coefficients tool for computing quotient tensors and descending balanced comparisons; it does not replace any geometric step of the proper-base-change unit.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q37-8c2a24c3e (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and all six steps in full, with no fixes written. Every cited statement checked out: adic datum (P_n finite, A commutative Noetherian), proetale-modules (constant coefficient sheaves, exact termwise nu^*), etale-origin-witness, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings, ringed-topoi derived tensor pullback (genuinely unbounded, with u^*P K-flat for flat-term K-flat P; here nu^{-1}(P_m)_et = (P_m)_proet, so u^* is the fixed-Lambda inverse image), prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level (exactness and unit, both used in Step 3), and thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison (fully faithful on D^+, used in Steps 4-6). The source sentence is in blueprint main-20261015 prop-weil-pbc-preservation-constructible.proof.md lines 15-20 ('compatible etale-origin witnesses are carried to compatible witnesses'). Stacks 09B1 (proetale.tex lemma-compare-derived (2)) gives only the D^+ comparison, so proof_origin 'by agent' is correct. Step 3 gets the D^+ bound before full faithfulness is used: exactness gives F_n H^i(C) = H^i(M_n) = 0 for i < a_n, and the unit reflects this to H^i(C) = 0, so there is no circularity. Steps 4-5 lift the isomorphism and its inverse, with uniqueness and beta_{n,n} = 1 from faithfulness. I expanded the Step 6 cocycle myself: naturality of c, the level-(k,m) equation, tensor associativity and the rho cocycle give alpha_n F_n beta_{k,n}, and the source C_{k,n} is in D^+. Small cases tested: m = n, zero objects, empty scheme, k = m, I = 0, zero ring. The M_n in D^+ hypothesis is needed (Z/l over Z/l^2 has unbounded Tor), and nothing is weakened. The parent's normalizations from the adic datum match the rho hypotheses. No new nodes; the grep for duplicates turned up only definitions and statements about geometric functors. I accept the declared tool_use of lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings as generic coefficient calculus. No SGA source is used.
